notes.title: Patch 1.1 for Robots at Midnight is officially live!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Patch 1.1 is Live! New Settings, Fixes, Languages & More [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This update brings a wave of community-requested improvements, new features, and expanded language support to make your journey through Yob even smoother and more immersive. Whether you’re here for the story or the challenge, there’s something new for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Game Modes: Play Your Way[/b][/h3][p]Patch 1.1 introduces the ability to switch between difficulty settings mid-game without losing your progress. You can now swap freely between:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hero Mode[/b]: Experience the action and story at an approachable pace[/p][/*][*][p][b]Master Mode[/b]: For players prepared to face a challenge [/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re finding things too easy or hitting a difficulty spike, this change lets you adjust on the fly without starting over. Just head to the Options Menu at any time to choose your preferred challenge level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/b2aa448013c17b269f889a2581e312e0c34aaebc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Language Support[/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to welcome even more players into [i]Robots at Midnight[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Russian, Turkish, and Ukrainian are now fully supported![/p][/*][*][p]Translation polish and typo fixes across all supported languages[/p][/*][*][p]Updated achievement translations for clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Visual Settings & Brightness Tuning[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added more options to help you customize your visual experience:[/p][list][*][p]Toggle Volumetric Fog[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Bloom and Ambient Occlusion[/p][/*][*][p]Updated lookup tables for improved tone and notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]Cryo-sleep ends at midnight on June 19, 2025, and your journey across the desolate landscapes of Yob — a world left in ruins and haunted by the machines once built to serve it — begins.

Battle corrupted machines, uncover hidden lore, and search for your missing father in this retro-futuristic action RPG.

Set your alarm to wake up at midnight by wishlisting Robots at Midnight now. [url=https://discord.gg/smGVU9SQg2]Join us on discord[/url] to stay up to date with exciting news, events and game updates! [/h3]
